text:
emma: Quick report: internal onboarding sample fails for Windows users on py3.10/3.11. Async example hits:
ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] unable to get local issuer certificate (_ssl.c:997)
Sync example (requests) works.

jon: Are they using the MS store build? Windows Python builds can behave differently re cert store.

emma: Using python.org installer on Win10. certifi installed.

marta: We've seen this across 3.8-3.12. httpx async path may not pick up REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE; need an explicit SSLContext or set SSL_CERT_FILE to certifi.where(). Also check cryptography version.

emma: I tried SSL_CERT_FILE but async still failed.

ryan: Two common causes: the Windows proactor loop + httpx's TLS defaults. Workaround that landed for me locally: force selector loop and pass an SSLContext created from certifi into AsyncClient. Example:

import ssl, certifi, asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

ssl_ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=certifi.where())
asyncio.set_event_loop_policy(asyncio.WindowsSelectorEventLoopPolicy())

async def main():
    async with AsyncClient(ssl=ssl_ctx) as c:
        print(await c.generate("hi"))

asyncio.run(main())

marta: Action items: add this snippet to Windows onboarding, detect Windows in samples and present the env var fallback, and ensure parity between sync and async clients. Our typing stubs are missing the ssl kwarg on AsyncClient so mypy flags it.

jon: Filed issue 2435 to track: "windows-async-ssl-sample-typing-ci". devex-bot: created issue 2435.

devex-bot: Issue 2435 created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/issues/2435

ryan: I'll open PR to: 1) use certifi.where() as a Windows fallback when no SSL context provided, 2) add Optional[ssl.SSLContext] to AsyncClient typing, and 3) include Windows runner across py3.8-3.12 in GH Actions.

emma: Thanks  that will help unblock our Windows demos. If anyone still sees verification failures after the PR, try upgrading cryptography and then post a tiny repro.

marta: tagging @platform for CI matrix update.
